reviews.text: Remi made an excellent job of my Cockapoo, just what I asked for. He is a nervous wee soul but she put him right at ease. Would thoroughly recommend.

Used to absolutely love this place and Ludo attended for around 2.5 years. The previous team were fantastic and Ludo genuinely adored staff like Abbie and Robyn — his tail would wag the second he saw them.

Unfortunately since the takeover, the atmosphere and customer experience feels quite different. We still used the daycare occasionally after reopening, but recently found ourselves removed from the customer WhatsApp group despite still being paying customers from time to time.

When questioned about it, the response felt unnecessarily defensive and dismissive rather than customer-focused.

It’s disappointing because we genuinely supported the business for a long time and had previously recommended it to others.

Avoid, avoid, avoid!!! My dog was booked in for a groom today at 9.30am. I totally forgot about the appointment which I accept was my fault. Even though I agreed to pay the £60 and they know I always pay cash they decided to take money out of my account. I have never said I wasn’t going to pay. I was happy to pay but just to go into my account and take money out is total rude. Very poor customer service and total scammers. Will definitely not be coming back. If they needed the money so badly could have just asked if I can pop in today to pay them the £60.

Let me see what their response will be, I can see they love arguing with customers who leave negative review… 😂😂😂
What an awesome groomers. They are amazing with your fur babies and take all information you have to give them very seriously, Bruno will definitely be back to Elite next time xxx

UPDATE (in response to below) - please see attached images which show you did not respond to our complaint and you’ve lied in your response below. I also believe you’ve now blocked our numbers as my follow up hasn’t delivered.

Extremely Disappointed — Injury to My Dog and No Response to Complaint

I took my dog Louis for a grooming appointment here on 6th August. After the groom and making payment, we were casually told after paying that he had a “small nick.” In reality, it was a deep cut that required a vet visit, antibiotics, and pain relief — costing us over £100. The vet said it was close to needing stitches.

What made the situation worse was how it was handled:
•	No phone call to inform us of the injury
•	No upfront honesty
•	And despite sending a formal complaint, offering proof of photos and vet bills, and a request for reimbursement, we received no response at all.

Accidents can happen, but this level of care, communication, and accountability is simply unacceptable — especially for a regular customer.
Oscar likes going there as he has went there since he was a pup the girls are great with him and he gets a great groom would recommend you take your dog for a great groom

Lovely young woman and made his first experience a truly happy one . They didn't force him when he didn't like around his face area cut but hopefully in time he will allow this . He's looking tidy clean and apart . Before and after pics added . Thank you girls he will definitely be coming back

Showed zero empathy for a loyal customer unable to make an appointment.  Went into great detail about my individual circumstances on why i couldn’t attend appointment fell on deaf ears and still went ahead and charged me £45 even though i had a genuine reason for not attending. So much for being a loyal customer, no respect shown in text correspondence. Zero costumer service just greedy for money.
thanks so much for the review means a lot to the staff
Expensive No continuity as high staff turnover though young groomers do their best. Refuse to  accept card payments, cash only and no receipts issued.

We took both our Spaniels here for their grooming and they are fantastic! Iona, my older girl, is very anxious and hates her grooming sessions but with patience and care, they made her look beautiful! Would highly recommend!
Really great service. My wee Ollie just loves Kayleigh and she always does a great job!
Took Ernie here today for his first groom and Kayleigh did a fantastic job! Thanks so much, will be back! Before and after photos attached!
Good service and prices. Kebbles and Lulu love it.
thanks for the review means a lot to our staff
Great place. Have been taking our dog here for a couple years now and he loves it. The girls are fantastic. Love the photo updates throughout the day too
